summary: This week in AI news, OpenAI and Anthropic are making strides in AI development, with OpenAI's new smart speaker and Anthropic's custom AI chip design. Meanwhile, companies like Suno and Cloudflare are working to combat AI-generated spam and make AI more accessible. Researchers are also exploring the potential of AI in fields like weather forecasting and customer support.
insight: The increasing focus on AI development and deployment is driving innovation, but also raises important questions about the potential risks and consequences of advanced AI systems, highlighting the need for responsible AI development and regulation.
highlights: OpenAI's new smart speaker is reportedly priced between $300 and $400
Anthropic is designing its own custom AI chips to improve efficiency
Suno is implementing watermarking technology to combat AI-generated music spam
